programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.title: Hysteria
programme.desc: Dems won big on Tuesday, and Leigh McGowan (PoliticsGirl) joins Erin to break down the results. They celebrate the blue tsunami, victories down the ballot, and the downfall of many fucking guys. Then they discuss how Dems can navigate their new majority in Trump’s veto-state and the path to tangible change. They wrap up in the sanity corner to discuss the WNBA Championships and the new rules for Woketopia.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It
programme.sub-title: Lovett or Leave It (Dan Dan Noodling)
programme.desc: America’s a haunted house, and Trump is our poltergeist. Are voters ready to bust some ghosts this midterm election season? Also, Alaska’s Mary Peltola can see two Dan Sullivans from her house, Obama orders another round of Republican ass-kicking for the table, and Lovett brings together the nation (to insult him on Twitter) to win Michigan for the Dems. This week, Zainab Johnson sticks to her guns, Todd Stashwick geeks out, and we all are scared stiff for The Egg of Spooky Truths. The Scream Wheel has us shrieking over lazy ghosts, respecting others’ fright levels, and LAX’s electrifying new people mover, and we get both tricks AND treats for Seconds Thoughts.

programme.title: Pod Save America
programme.desc: Live from DC, Jon, Lovett, Tommy, Alex, and Dan break down all the latest news from the aftermath of Democrats’ huge wins on Tuesday, from JD Vance’s attempted break with Trump to what the incoming majorities’ top priorities should be. Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed drops by to talk about standing up to Donald Trump, building consensus on saving Americans’ health care, and his eye-opening caffeine regimen. Then, Gov. JB Pritzker outlines a plan for standing up for working Americans, why Elon Musk’s millions didn’t get results, and why Democrats shouldn’t unilaterally disarm in the redistricting fight. Then, Pritzker joins the hosts for a round of Two Takes and a Fake, featuring the right’s most outrageous reactions to the blue tsunami.

programme.title: What a Day
programme.sub-title: What a Day (Latino Voters' Rebuke of Trump)
programme.desc: Most midterm voters said that President Donald Trump’s own policies had smothered growth and driven costs even higher, according to the AP Voter Poll. But how did those economic concerns resonate with Latino voters? On today’s show, Jane speaks with New Jersey Democratic Representative Rob Menendez, Vice Chair of Policy for the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, about the Latino vote and what this week revealed.

programme.title: Runaway Country with Alex Wagner
programme.sub-title: Runaway Country with Alex Wagner (Blue Crush)
programme.desc: The midterm elections brought historic victories, jaw dropping flips from red to blue, and a resounding rejection of Trumpism. This week Alex speaks to Jamie Ager, the first Democrat to win in North Carolina’s 11th congressional district in 15 years. Then, she talks to Brian Tyler Cohen about the energy a new set of leaders could bring to the Democratic party, and the importance of embracing the big tent and broad range of views they represent. Finally, she hears from Senator Bernie Sanders on what message American voters sent to Washington on November 3rd, and what Democrats can realistically achieve with a majority in Congress while lame duck Trump is still in office.

programme.title: Wired To Hunt
programme.sub-title: Wired To Hunt | S13 E1027 | What 100+ Farms Taught Us About Big Bucks | Wired to Hunt Ep. 1027
programme.desc: What can 100+ farms teach us about big bucks? To answer it, Jake is joined by Jack Huston with Midwest Deer Surveys, who has flown hundreds of properties with thermal drones and seen exactly where deer are - and more importantly, where they aren’t. From density rings and social stress to bedding, pressure, and why “thicker” farms consistently produce, this episode challenges a lot of conventional thinking. We also get into how doe harvest impacts herds over time, what role genetics actually play, and why many hunters don’t struggle killing deer.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast
programme.sub-title: The MeatEater Podcast - Theodore Roosevelt on Love, Ladies, and Conservation | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 841 - 12 - 841
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with author of The Loves Of Theodore Roosevelt and CEO of the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, Ed O'Keefe. Joined by Randall Williams, Phil Taylor, and Corinne Schneider. Topics discussed: The ladies in Teddy's life; being a sickly child and powering through pain; hunting to study; a tremendous taxidermy collection; a family that founded so many museums; sisters as advisors and confidants; a life-altering Valentine's Day tragedy; when a thick manuscript in your front jacket pocket stops a bullet and saves your life; being the first president to embrace women's suffrage and the right to own property; one of the most beloved in American history; and more. programme.title: All In The Family
programme.sub-title: Flashback: Mike And Gloria's Wedding - Pt. Ii
programme.desc: The family continues to reminisce on Mike and Gloria's second wedding anniversary and they recall the actual day Mike and Gloria got married. As Archie and Mike's Uncle Casimir continue to butt heads, Edith must gather up strength to tell Gloria about 'the birds and the bees'.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: When Edith finds some old lottery tickets that she has totally forgotten about, Archie hits the roof claiming she was wasting money. However, Archie's attitude quickly changes when the family discovers that one of the tickets is a winner, but there is a catch: Edith claims the tickets don't belong to her, but belong to George Jefferson.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: One morning Archie gets up, goes to his front door to get the newspaper and is shocked to discover that someone has painted a swastika on his front door. Archie soon gets into a debate with Mike as to who could have painted it and why. As Archie is calling the police to report it, the Bunker home gets a visit from a man from a Hebrew vigilante group who wants to plan some retaliation.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: Archie comes home in a fantastic mood for a change and it's all because he has the chance to possibly join a prestigious bowling team, the Cannonballers. After waiting six years, it seems that there is finally a vacancy on the team and Archie is planning to try out, even though the team practices discrimination in admitting members.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: Archie has been suffering from a terrible pain in his back and has become a terrible pain to Edith, who has been waiting on him hand and foot. When the doctor takes a look at him, he orders Archie to be admitted to the hospital for tests. This is where Archie befriends the other patient in his room, but because of a partition, Archie doesn't realize the man is black.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: Archie begins to realize that he's not as young as he used to be when he finds that he may need glasses. To make matters worse, middle-aged Archie can only envy the eternally youthful outlook of his friend and contemporary, Bill Mulheron. He is especially impressed that the toned, flashily garbed Bill has managed to attract a sexy young bedmate named Tina. However, Archie soon discovers all is not as it seems.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: Archie is searching the house for a magazine to prove to Mike that he was right concerning a debate that they are having. However, Archie oversteps his boundaries and searches Mike's room where he discovers a poem that Mike once wrote. This leads to a huge argument concerning privacy and Mike storms out to Lionel's while Gloria and Edith storm out and have a slumber party at the apartment of one of Gloria's friends.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: Edith gets an invitation to attend her 30th high school class reunion, but when Archie refuses to escort her, she decides not to go. When her Cousin Amelia shows up to question Edith about her decision, Edith learns that an old flame, Buck, will be attending the reunion. Suddenly, Archie decides that he would like to go. However, when Buck does finally show up, Archie is in for a surprise since the once good looking track star seems to have lost his good looks.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: Archie comes home with a brand new watch and claims that he got a bargain on it, since he was told that it was a $300 watch and he got it for $25. Later, Archie is crestfallen when he discovers that the watch is broken. Meanwhile, Mike is convinced that the watch is stolen and encourages Archie to be careful, since the serial number may lead the jeweler to discover that indeed Archie has a hot watch. Thus, Archie scrambles to find a jeweler who will fix it with no questions asked.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: Archie, Edith, Mike and Gloria go out to a French restaurant and recall the events of the day. Each one of them has a vastly different version of the day's events. It seems that the Bunker's refrigerator is on the fritz and a pair of repairmen enter the scene. However, in the end, the fridge doesn't get repaired and it's Edith's version of the day that explains why it didn't get fixed.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: Archie swears Edith into secrecy when he begins attending night-school classes to qualify for a high school diploma in hopes of getting a promotion at work. However, Edith spills the beans and soon Mike and Archie must learn to share a study space, but that proves to be difficult.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: Gloria comes home from work in a most unusual mood. She later confides in Edith that on the way to work, she had been attacked by a construction worker near a construction site. When Mike and Archie find out about this, they try to encourage her to report it, but she is hesitant and totally uncomfortable with the idea of telling a detective all the details of the crime.

programme.title: All In The Family
programme.desc: Being her time of the month, Gloria is in a complete foul mood and gets into a big argument with Edith, lambasting her for letting Archie boss her around. Soon, Gloria gets into a big fight with Mike and decides to sleep on the couch, however, no one can sleep when Mike and Gloria's bickering keeps Archie and Edith up. Meanwhile, all of this puts a damper on Gloria's birthday celebration.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

programme.sub-title: Never Trust A Little Old Lady

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: It's So Peaceful In The Country

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Take Your Wife To A Convention
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Sencillamente Maity Interiano
programme.sub-title: Amara La Negra: Perdonar y sanar
programme.desc: Vivió en su carro. Creció con heridas profundas. Y aun así, eligió perdonar. En esta entrevista, la actriz y presentadora Amara La Negra abre su corazón como pocas veces: su dura infancia.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Lissette Engel denuncia que el gobierno ha permitido al IRS compartir con ICE información de personas indocumentadas que declaran impuestos usando un ITIN. A pesar del miedo a las deportaciones.

programme.title: Sencillamente Maity Interiano
programme.sub-title: Jacky Bracamontes: El dolor de madre
programme.desc: Hay conversaciones que te marcan… y esta es una de ellas. En este episodio de Sencillamente Maity Interiano, me siento con Jacky Bracamontes para hablar sobre lo que realmente importa: el matrimonio.

programme.title: Airing Break

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Ezequiel Hernández expone que las agencias federales han comenzado a derivar casos de asilo pendientes a cortes de deportación con un alto índice de negación de fianzas.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Nicolás Ibarguen relata cómo los hipopótamos llevados por Pablo Escobar se tornaron en una especie invasora que pone en grave riesgo al ecosistema de Colombia. Para detener su sacrificio.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Fernanda Echavarri esclarece cómo el fútbol soccer aterrizó primero en Estados Unidos que en América Latina, siendo luego superado drásticamente por el fútbol americano.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Guadalupe Loaeza asegura que México sigue sumido en el mismo clasismo y desigualdad de hace cuarenta años, situación ahora adoptada por las élites del movimiento 4T.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Ninoska Pérez acoge con emoción la imputación legal contra Raúl Castro, autor de la orden de derribar aeronaves civiles en espacio aéreo internacional en 1996.

programme.title: Entrevistas Completas de "Jorge Ramos: Así Veo las Cosas"
programme.desc: Niña Pastori habla sobre su álbum "Color Fania", valorando el esfuerzo técnico de versionar piezas de salsa con su característica identidad vocal flamenca. En otro ámbito.

programme.title: Tomorrow Never Dies
programme.desc: For a deranged media tycoon (Jonathan Pryce), ratings are everything…even if it means global destruction. Now, 007 (Pierce Brosnan) must take on this evil mastermind in an adrenaline-charged battle to end his reign of terror! Judi Dench also stars.

programme.title: The World Is Not Enough
programme.desc: When Agent 007 (Pierce Brosnan) is assigned to protect a beautiful oil heiress (Sophie Marceau), he is catapulted into a passionate, adrenaline-charged adventure that pits him against one of his most deadly adversaries (Robert Carlyle) ever.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: 007 (Pierce Brosnan) pulls out all the stops in this adrenaline-pumping adventure when a shadowy billionaire (Toby Stephens) develops a diabolical weapon that could bring the world to its knees! Halle Berry, Rick Yune and Judi Dench also star.

programme.title: GoldenEye
programme.desc: The effortlessly suave and sophisticated Pierce Brosnan makes his debut as Agent 007 in this rip-roaring espionage thriller that finds Bond faced with his deadliest enemy yet...an MI6 agent gone rogue (Sean Bean) who is intent on world domination!
